indirect_reasons: Healbane's 4-stack ceiling 82.2%->72% means his Spirit Lifesteal/Napalm sustain is harder to fully suppress — a real but small gain.
The same change weakens his own Toxic Bullets + Healbane two-source package (57.8%->54.7%), which was his answer to dedicated healers.
build_changes: Treat Toxic Bullets as a damage item first; the 40% heal-cut stacked on Healbane is no longer a hard anti-sustain combo.
Keep one anti-heal source on the team, not two — the second buyer gets ~3 points of heal-cut instead of coverage.
heroes.one_liner: His burn-lifesteal shell survives stacked anti-heal a little better, but his own Healbane answer is softer — a wash.

indirect_reasons: Healbane sits in his spirit AoE core as the sustain-comp answer; with the 2-stack case 57.8%->54.7% and the ceiling 82.2%->72%, that counter-build is less of a hard counter.
Ivy (a listed Seven loss, 42%-ish) is one of the clearest Healbane-stacking winners, so the tether he could previously shut down comes back.
build_changes: Keep Healbane as your single anti-heal slot, but if a teammate already runs it, spend that Vitality slot elsewhere — the second source is now worth far less.
No change to the Monster Rounds/Cultist Sacrifice farm spine; the jungle economy is untouched.
heroes.one_liner: Still the fastest farmer in the game; Healbane is just a worse second buy when a teammate already has it.

indirect_reasons: Celeste took a kit-wide nerf (Shining Wonder slow -32%->-28%, cooldown 160->170s, Radiant Daggers cast range 30->25m) and is one of Vindicta's worst lanes at 46%.
heroes.one_liner: Nothing in her notes; one bad lane (Celeste) got gutted, but the flyer tax is unchanged.

indirect_reasons: She buys no Healbane, so the anti-heal stack trim is pure upside: Radiant Regeneration and Mystic Regeneration are harder to fully suppress.
Drifter's anti-heal bruiser variant (Veil Walker/Healbane/Tankbuster) is the composition the stack nerf hits hardest — and Drifter is a listed Geist loss.
Celeste, one of the falling spirit-caster rivals her Soul-Exchange line was measured against, lost cast range and slow.
build_changes: Regen core (Extra Regen/Mystic Regeneration/Radiant Regeneration) is now slightly more reliable out of the dive — no swap needed.
heroes.one_liner: Stacked anti-heal can't choke her regen as hard anymore, so the sustain bruiser gets a small refund.

indirect_reasons: He doesn't buy Healbane, so the stack trim only helps: Siphon Life and his regen shell are harder to shut off with multi-source anti-heal.
Celeste (45% vs him, spirit burst that outranges a static frontline) took a kit-wide nerf — small relief on a listed loss.
heroes.one_liner: Untouched; the anti-heal ceiling drop just makes his Siphon sustain slightly harder to answer.

indirect_reasons: Celeste (a listed loss) lost silence duration and slow, trimming one bad lane.
Ivy's tether heals are now harder to stack anti-heal onto, and Ivy is also a listed loss — roughly cancels the above.
heroes.one_liner: Untouched again: one bad lane got easier, another got harder, nothing in her gun core moved.

indirect_reasons: Celeste's nerf trims one of the AoE spirit bursters that clears her turret stacks.
Lady Geist's regen survived the anti-heal trim, and her AoE spirit burst is also a turret-clearing counter.
Her own Healbane only appears in the niche zoning build, so the stack nerf barely touches her.
heroes.one_liner: No notes: her turret farm is untouched, and the Celeste/Geist bursters that clear her zone traded one for one.

indirect_reasons: Celeste, a listed loss at 43%, lost Radiant Daggers cast range 30m->25m, T3 silence -1.25s->-0.75s and Shining Wonder slow -32%->-28% — the out-trade lane gets noticeably softer.
heroes.one_liner: No lines for her; one losing lane got weaker, which doesn't fix a 46% hero.

indirect_reasons: Mo & Krill — his worst listed loss — got Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x, Burrow damage radius +0.5m and Combo health per kill 40->50, so the durable frontline that eats Singularity is better at exactly that.
Sand Blast T2 now slows -28% (from -24%) and cuts dash distance -28% (from -26%), making his engage easier to peel.
No item driver: he buys no Healbane and nothing in his Extra Charge/Arcane Surge/Refresher spine moved.
build_changes: Keep Unstoppable/Refresher on the channel — expect more Mo & Krill frontlines that survive the whole ult.
Value Mystic Expansion/duration for wider Singularity pulls rather than trying to out-burst the frontline.
heroes.one_liner: Still wins the scheduled hub fights, but Mo & Krill's buffs make the wall that eats Singularity taller.

indirect_reasons: Healbane one source is untouched but the ceiling dropped 82.2%->72% and stacks decay 20% faster — the multi-source anti-heal plan that was his worst system change can no longer fully shut off Frozen Shelter or Healing Booster.
Drifter, a listed Kelvin loss, leaned on the anti-heal bruiser composition this nerf targets.
build_changes: Healbane stays a fine buy for your own team anti-heal; don't expect a second or third source on the enemy team to blank your dome anymore.
Extra Regen/Healing Booster spirit core is unchanged — keep funding heal throughput.
heroes.one_liner: Stacked anti-heal can't fully blank the dome now, so the best healer in the game gets quietly better.

indirect_reasons: Celeste (42% vs her, burst that beats her before Fixation stacks) lost T3 silence +0.5s of duration, slow and 5m of cast range — a real listed loss softened.

Apollo gained a Riposte disarm plus a longer T2 disable (+0.6s->+0.7s) and Itani Lo Sahn T3 +50%->+60%; the disarm directly turns off her gun window, though the pommel is an immobilize and no longer interrupts channels.
build_changes: Watch the melee-range lane against Apollo: a Riposte disarm now blanks your Fixation window, so hold Surge of Power or reposition instead of trading through it.
heroes.one_liner: Untouched; Celeste's nerf helps her, Apollo's new Riposte disarm makes the lane trades riskier.

indirect_reasons: Mo & Krill, her listed hard loss, got Sand Blast T2 to -28% slow and -28% dash distance (from -24%/-26%), a bigger Burrow radius (+0.5m) and Combo health per kill 40->50 — point-blank lockdown that punishes her commit got stronger across the kit.
Her own anti-heal/Healbane exposure is nil, so the item change does nothing for her.
build_changes: Buy Unstoppable/Debuff Reducer earlier into Mo & Krill — the -28% slow and larger Burrow radius make the entry harder to escape.
Lean on bounce-pad pre-placement rather than reactive lasso commits into the tank frontline.
heroes.one_liner: Nothing in her notes, but Mo & Krill's stronger slow and bigger Burrow make her worst matchup worse.

indirect_reasons: Celeste, a listed counter (he wins 44% into her), lost Dazzling Trick silence (T3 +1.25s->+0.75s), Radiant Daggers range (30m->25m) and Shining Wonder cooldown (160s->170s) — a small relief in a lane he was losing.
Healbane's stacked ceiling falls 82.2%->72%, so the sustain that already erases his burst (Kelvin, 42%) is now harder for a second buyer to cut — a small extra tax on the hook combo.
heroes.one_liner: No lines for Bebop; a single-target hook still has nothing to punish in this economy.

indirect_reasons: Apollo, a 55% winner into her, added a Riposte Pommel Hit disarm, a parry-ending Pummel and T2 duration 0.6s->0.7s; a disarm barely touches her melee-spirit burst, so the squeeze is small.
heroes.one_liner: Untouched kit, untouched jungle income — still a sharper diver with no safety net.
Nothing in this patch fixes a sub-50% flyer with no camp or crate route.

direct_reasons: Scorn heal from heroes 1.2x->1.3x raises the sustain that is his survive-the-fight engine.
Burrow damage radius +0.5m makes the AoE his camp clear and dive both wider.
Combo health per kill 40->50, so finishing the grab pays more than it did.
Sand Blast T2 re-tunes the slow/dash cut to a flat -28% (from -24% slow / -26% dash): tagged a nerf in the notes, but the numbers read as a wash.
indirect_reasons: Healbane's stacking ceiling drops 82.2%->72% with 20% faster decay, so the multi-source anti-heal aimed at his Scorn sustain is materially weaker.
Celeste, his 46% matchup, ate kit-wide nerfs (Dazzling Trick silence T3 +1.25s->+0.75s, Shining Wonder 160s->170s), removing kiting pressure from a lane he loses.
build_changes: Scorn 1.2x->1.3x rewards holding Scorn for hero contact instead of burning it on a camp; with the anti-heal ceiling capped, one Healbane on the team is enough — second and third copies are no longer worth a slot.
Combo HP per kill 40->50 pushes the kill-complete play over poke: Burrow in, grab, finish — not a Burrow-and-walk-away.
heroes.one_liner: More Scorn healing, a bigger Burrow, +10 HP per grab — the tank holds targets and now survives doing it.

indirect_reasons: Healbane's stack ceiling falls 82.2%->72% with 20% faster decay, so the Radiant Regeneration + Spirit Lifesteal shell he fights out of is far less punishable by a team's second and third anti-heal source.
His own Healbane is a single source and is untouched — his heal-cut into bruisers does not change.
build_changes: Do not re-add out-of-combat regen: Radiant Regeneration is still in-combat-only, but stacked enemy anti-heal is now weaker, so Spirit Lifesteal + Torment Pulse carry the buff instead of another regen slot.
heroes.one_liner: Weaker stacked anti-heal buys his regen stack back some buffer; he still starts fights smaller than pre-10-30.

indirect_reasons: The 10-30 multi-source Healbane stack that specifically crushed tether healing is capped: 4-stack 82.2%->72%, 2-stack 57.8%->54.7%, decay 20% more aggressive.
Mo & Krill, her 48% matchup, gained Scorn 1.2x->1.3x, +0.5m Burrow radius and +10 Combo HP per kill — displacement she cannot heal through got better.
build_changes: Run exactly one Healbane on the team, not three: the first source is unchanged and the marginal second/third slot is now worth more as any other Vitality item.
Healing Booster/tether support gets a small relative rebound; the gun core (Titanic Magazine/Tesla Bullets) is still the build to fund.
heroes.one_liner: The anti-heal stack ceiling came down, so her tethers hold longer — gun core is still the build.

indirect_reasons: Healbane's stacked cut is weaker, so the sustain he has to cage through (Ivy 48%) is marginally harder to suppress, and Mo & Krill — who tanks his cage — took direct Scorn/Burrow/Combo buffs.
heroes.one_liner: Nothing for Warden this patch; his late gun window is the same race against the clock.

indirect_reasons: Celeste, her 41% worst matchup, lost Dazzling Trick silence duration (T3 +1.25s->+0.75s), Radiant Daggers range (30m->25m) and Shining Wonder cooldown (160s->170s).
Mo & Krill, her 42% matchup, got Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x plus Burrow radius and Combo HP buffs — the sustain she cannot burst got better too, offsetting the Celeste gain.
heroes.one_liner: Celeste's nerfs open one lane, but the sustain tank she cannot burst just got tankier.
Untouched, still the top-pick initiator — nothing here blunts the grapple-dive loop.

indirect_reasons: Mo & Krill, his 43% frontline loss, gained Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x, Burrow damage radius +0.5m and Combo HP per kill 40->50 — the tank-sustain that already out-trades him got better.
Healbane's stacked ceiling falls 82.2%->72%, which helps sustain comps generally but gives his own poke-and-Cube shell nothing specific.
heroes.one_liner: No lines for Viscous, and the M&K buff makes the frontline he loses to harder to grind.

indirect_reasons: Celeste, his 39% worst matchup, lost Dazzling Trick silence (T3 +1.25s->+0.75s), Radiant Daggers range (30m->25m) and Shining Wonder cooldown (160s->170s) — the burst that out-ranged him is smaller.
Healbane's stacked cut (82.2%->72%) makes team heal-cut weaker, which marginally hurts a DoT-burst carry trying to close through sustain; small and second-order.
heroes.one_liner: Celeste nerfs soften his worst lane; the Affliction ramp still needs the game to last.

indirect_reasons: Mo & Krill, his 40% matchup, gained Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x, Burrow radius +0.5m and Combo HP per kill 40->50 — the silence/combo that already locked him down got stronger.
His own Healbane is a single source and is unchanged (57.8%->54.7% only hits the second source), so his anti-heal core buys the same thing it did.
build_changes: Keep one Healbane, not two: the second copy on your team now pays about three points less heal-cut.
Split-push still converts worse than corridor farming after 10-20 — route through camps and take Djinn's Mark picks on isolated clearers.
heroes.one_liner: The split-pusher gets nothing back, and the tank that silence-locks him got stronger.

indirect_reasons: No direct lines; Mo & Krill, one of her listed losing matchups, gained Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x and +0.5m Burrow radius, making the lift/combo dive on her cleaner.
Healbane's multi-source nerf does not reach her: no Healbane in her gun core and no kit sustain to protect.
heroes.one_liner: Nothing in the notes for her; her CC-counter Mo & Krill only got tankier, so the ~46% sits still.
Untouched again: no item in his duration/cooldown shell moved and his divers did not change.

indirect_reasons: Her two worst listed matchups both eased for the enemy: Mo & Krill got Scorn 1.2x->1.3x plus +0.5m Burrow radius, and Ivy gains from the Healbane stacking cut.
Weaker stacked anti-heal does nothing for her single-target rotation, which already loses to sustain.
heroes.one_liner: Same 44.7% niche: the tanks she can't kill (Mo & Krill) and the healer she can't out-burst (Ivy) both got slightly better.

indirect_reasons: Healbane's 2-source cut 57.8%->54.7% specifically devalues his anti-heal bruiser variant, which stacked his built-in heal cut on top of Healbane/Toxic Bullets.
Apollo's Riposte rework (added disarm, T2 +0.6s->+0.7s) sharpens a listed loss, and Mo & Krill's Scorn 1.2x->1.3x hardens another.
build_changes: Default to the spirit melee core (Melee Lifesteal/Stalker/Spirit Strike); the anti-heal bruiser package is now the weaker buy into healing comps.
heroes.one_liner: Still a blind-pickable bruiser, but his anti-heal variant lost its edge and two of his losing lanes got buffed.
No lines, and neither his trap-clearer Graves nor his tank counters moved; he is the same 46.7% gun-bruiser.

indirect_reasons: Anti-heal stacking is a listed counter to his grind-down shell, and the 4-stack Healbane ceiling fell 82.2%->72%, so Spirit Lifesteal/Healing Booster sustain is harder to fully suppress.
Offset: Mo & Krill, a 47% matchup for him, gained Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x and Combo 40->50 health per kill.
heroes.one_liner: Quietly helped: the anti-heal that counters his sustain shell got weaker, and his own numbers are untouched.

indirect_reasons: Multi-source Healbane is listed as the anti-heal counter to her heal/lane-pressure shell, and its 2-source value fell 57.8%->54.7% (4-stack 82.2%->72%).
Ivy, her toughest support matchup, gains from the same anti-heal cut, so the heal-duel stays roughly even.
heroes.one_liner: 55.6% lane bully untouched, and the stacked anti-heal teams used to answer her heals is weaker now.

indirect_reasons: Apollo's Riposte rework (added disarm, T2 +0.6s->+0.7s) sharpens a dive-tempo lane he already loses; his own spirit/charge shell took no item hits.
heroes.one_liner: Same late setup initiator at 45.6%: the Bell carry build is untouched, one dive counter just got a disarm.

indirect_reasons: Stacked anti-heal is listed as his counter, and multi-source Healbane just lost value (4-stack 82.2%->72%), buying his brawl a little more room.
Offset: Mo & Krill, the frontline he out-brawls, gained Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x and Combo 40->50 health per kill.
heroes.one_liner: Roughly a wash: anti-heal teams hurt him less, but the tank he beats got a bit more sustain.
Nothing touches her shell — no Healbane in it, no counter buffed — so the 57.5% top win rate stands.

direct_reasons: Riposte Pommel Hit now also disarms, turning his parry punish into a hard shutdown of a gun carry's M1 window on top of the existing immobilize.
Riposte T2 duration +0.6s->+0.7s and Itani Lo Sahn T3 +50%->+60% bonus damage both lengthen or strengthen the pick he already converts.
Pummel hit now ends a preexisting parry on the target — the least clear line (it strips the enemy's parry state rather than Apollo's), so treat one edge of this kit as unresolved.
indirect_reasons: Restorative Locket is his sustain slot and heal-stacking via Healbane is now weaker (2-source 57.8%->54.7%), so enemy anti-heal coverage of his Locket shell shrinks.
build_changes: Value Riposte as a duel/pick tool vs gun carries now that it disarms — hold the parry for their sustained-fire commit rather than fishing for channel interrupts (it is still an immobilize, not a stun).
heroes.one_liner: Riposte now disarms, holds 0.1s longer, and Itani Lo Sahn T3 hits harder — his pick punish finally has teeth.

rows.label: Parry strip
rows.text: Pummel hit ends target's preexisting parry

indirect_reasons: His percent-max-HP kit heal is exactly what the Healbane stacking cut protects — 2-source 57.8%->54.7% and decay 20% more aggressive means fewer full-strength heal cuts land.
Ivy, the support who owns his slot in the heal duel, gains from the same change, so the item-side lift doesn't win him the pick.
heroes.one_liner: Anti-heal stacking got weaker, which is worth more to a percent-HP healer than anything else in this patch.

indirect_reasons: Rat King's bullet damage 5.7->5.8, ammo 24->26 and Rule, Ratannia! T1 -25s cooldown strengthen the hero who beats her 62% — a real cost in her worst lane.
Healbane's stacked heal-cut ceiling 82.2%->72% makes her Melee Lifesteal/Restorative Shot sustain harder to fully suppress, a small offset.
heroes.one_liner: Nothing for her directly; Rat King got better and anti-heal got worse, roughly a wash at 46%.

direct_reasons: Dazzling Trick T3 silence +1.25s->+0.75s cuts her pick window by 40% on the ability that sets up her burst.
Radiant Daggers cast range 30m->25m forces her closer, and the spirit amp per stack 7%->6% trims the payoff of the same ability.
Shining Wonder nerfed on every axis: slow -32%->-28%, cooldown 160s->170s, bounce 15.5m->15m, T1 slow -16%->-14%, T2 damage +90->+80.
indirect_reasons: Healbane's stacked ceiling 82.2%->72% slightly relieves her Spirit Lifesteal/Torment Pulse sustain, but she never bought the item herself so the gain is one-sided and small.
build_changes: Shining Wonder at 170s is a fight-defining cast, not a rotation tool — stop valuing ult uptime and buy damage/uptime elsewhere.
Silence T3 1.25->0.75s weakens the pick setup; lean on Spirit Lifesteal + Torment Pulse as the sustain layer rather than the gutted regen shell.
heroes.one_liner: Every tool she picks with got shorter: silence, cast range, ult slow and ult cooldown all down.

direct_reasons: Rule, Ratannia! T1 now also cuts 25s of cooldown, directly buying back part of the 180s ult timer that was his post-10-30 problem.
Bullet damage 5.7->5.8 and ammo 24->26 feed the Monster Rounds/HVR gun-bruiser core that is his primary build.
Rule, Ratannia! move speed +3m->+4m improves the banner window he uses to force hub fights.
indirect_reasons: Healbane's stacked heal-cut ceiling 82.2%->72% makes his regen/Fortitude frontline harder to fully suppress — the anti-heal answer to him is weaker.
Baba's spirit-resist scaling 0.7->0.5 and melee damage -10% remove pressure from a fellow S-tier frontline contesting the same crates and hubs.
build_changes: Take Rule, Ratannia! T1 earlier — the -25s cooldown is now the cheapest fix for the 180s ult, ahead of Superior/Compress Cooldown.
Scrap Grenade fuse-extension 0.4s->0.25s makes the melee-the-fuse trick less reliable; pull camps with melee first, then grenade the clump.
heroes.one_liner: Buffs land on the exact spots 10-30 hit: ammo, bullet damage, banner speed and a 25s ult cooldown cut.

direct_reasons: Spirit Resistance scaling 0.7->0.5 is a ~29% cut to the resist wall her regen bruiser build stands behind.
Melee damage per boon -10% and Granny Long Legs melee/debuff resist 30%->25% trim both her heavy-melee crate clear and her brawl durability.
Baba's Brew cooldown 27s->28s, cycle 1.5s->1.6s and burn spirit scaling 0.15->0.13 slow the random-order brew she already cannot control.
indirect_reasons: Healbane's stacked ceiling 82.2%->72% is a small relief for a regen-wall hero, but single-source anti-heal is untouched so the counter still works.
Rat King's bullet damage, ammo and ult-cooldown buffs strengthen the frontline she competes with for crates and hub space.
build_changes: Spirit Resistance scaling 0.7->0.5 makes resist-stacking slots worse — put the spend into cooldown/duration (Compress Cooldown, Superior Cooldown) instead.
Melee damage -10% per boon weakens the Granny Long Legs crate route; still open Tough Crates, but stop treating melee as a damage source.
heroes.one_liner: Resist scaling and melee both cut again, but 54.4% win rate says she is still a top frontline.

indirect_reasons: Two of his three worst lanes were nerfed in the same patch — Baba (spirit resist scaling 0.7->0.5, melee -10%) and Celeste (silence, cast range, ult) — while Rat King, his other loss, was buffed.
Healbane's stacked ceiling 82.2%->72% does nothing for him: his usage data shows no Healbane, so the anti-heal change is neutral here.
heroes.one_liner: His two worst matchups got nerfed, but a 46.5% floor and a buffed Rat King keep him at D.

direct_reasons: Close The Deal bonus damage to under-half targets +75%->+55% cuts the execute that defines his dive-pick identity by a fifth.
Strix Salvo spirit scaling -8% hits the ability his primary spirit-mark build scales everything into.
Chimera Mk1 T2 heal-on-hit 150->125 and heal spirit scaling 2.0->1.7 remove sustain from a 730-HP flyer who has to commit to every dive.
indirect_reasons: Healbane's stacked ceiling 82.2%->72% does not help him — his problem is incoming burst, not suppressed healing.
Rat King's buffs are irrelevant to him; his real counters (Kelvin, Paige, Celeste, Vyper) are unchanged or, for Celeste, nerfed on the ult rather than the burst that kills him.
build_changes: Chimera Mk1 T2 heal 150->125 with 2.0->1.7 scaling makes heal-on-hit a weaker talent — Reactive Barrier and Grit carry the dive instead.
With the execute at +55%, stop diving targets above half HP expecting the mark to finish them; commit only on already-chipped targets.
heroes.one_liner: Execute cut to +55%, Salvo scaling down 8% and the jetpack heal trimmed — the dive pays less.

indirect_reasons: Healbane's stacked heal-cut ceiling 82.2%->72% protects the regen stack she actually buys (Radiant Regeneration 96%, Mystic Regeneration 93%, Healing Booster 78%) from multi-source anti-heal.
Baba's spirit-resist scaling 0.7->0.5 and melee -10% soften one of her 41% losing lanes; Rat King's buffs worsen the other.
heroes.one_liner: Anti-heal stacking got weaker, which is the one thing her regen-heavy build needed; still 50.8%.

direct_reasons: Bullet damage +8% is a straight gain for a hero whose primary build is Titanic Magazine mag-dump uptime.
Lurking Terrors fear buildup 2s->1.75s makes her lockdown land a quarter-second sooner, tightening the channel window she wins fights in.
Lurking Terrors vertical angle 50%->65% widens the cone so off-angle targets above and below her now get feared.
indirect_reasons: Healbane's stacked ceiling 82.2%->72% is a small relief for a dedicated healer whose entire sustain is healing-based, though single-source anti-heal still answers her.
Rat King's buffs put more of the frontline she beats (59% into Billy-class brawlers) into lobbies, which suits her cone.
build_changes: Bullet damage +8% reinforces Titanic Magazine as the weapon core — no reason to revisit HVR/Active Reload.
Fear buildup 2s->1.75s makes Lurking Terrors a reliable opener rather than a follow-up; lead with it.
heroes.one_liner: Faster fear, wider cone and +8% bullet damage — small buffs that steady a falling A-tier.
